winConditions.title: Attack With Zero Security
text: When your Digimon attacks your opponent directly and their security stack has 0 cards, your attack is successful and you win the game.
This is the primary win condition — reduce the opponent's security to zero, then land one more attack.

winConditions.title: Empty Deck
text: If a player has 0 cards in their deck and cannot draw during their draw phase, they lose the game.
This is checked continuously — once a player's deck runs out, they meet a defeat condition.

winConditions.title: Card Effect
text: Some card effects can cause a player to win or lose the game. When such an effect resolves, the game ends accordingly.

winConditions.title: Concession
text: Either player may declare a forfeit at any time. The conceding player immediately loses.
A forfeit is never forced and effects don't trigger for a loss by forfeit.
